name: Redundant condition
description: Flags a compound condition clause that is dominated or duplicated by another clause on the same identifier.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a clause in a compound `&&` / `||` condition that is redundant given another clause on the same local or property identifier with a constant numeric threshold (e.g. `x > 10 && x > 5`, where `x > 5` is implied by `x > 10`, or `x == 5 || x == 5`). Only direct relational comparisons (`==`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) against a numeric literal, plus identical identifier/property clauses, are checked; calls, aliases, and mixed identifiers are left unflagged rather than guessed at.
